# Master profile
Everything that is true about you, with no length limit. CVs are built from this document.
## Contacts
Name, city, email, phone, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio.
## Experience
Every job: company, role, dates, responsibilities, tech stack.
## Projects
Games and products: title, platform, engine, your area of responsibility, links.
## Achievements with numbers
- What you did → the measurable result (FPS, crashes, deadlines, metrics).
## Skills
Programming languages, engines, tools, practices.
## Education
Schools, courses, certificates.
## Languages
Language — level.
## Interview stories (STAR)
### Story title
- **Situation:** - **Task:** - **Action:** - **Result:**
